top_signal.title: I built and scaled a business, lost everything, and I’m trying to figure out my next move. Looking for advice from experienced entrepreneurs.
top_signal.summary: I’m posting this because I feel stuck, and I’d genuinely appreciate some perspective from people who have built successful businesses and created financial independence.  I’ve previously owned a company and successfully scaled it. I know what it takes to manage operations, solve problems, and grow a business. Unfortunately, I learned some very hard lessons along the way.  I didn’t come from money, and I didn’t have a financial safety net or an emergency fund behind the business. I invested my entire life savings into it because I believed in what I was building. When our equipment was essentially vandalized, the cost of repairs became so overwhelming that it ultimately put me out of business.  I lost the money I’d worked so hard to save, and rebuilding financially has been difficult. Looking back, I realize how important cash reserves, risk management, and protecting yourself against unexpected setbacks are. I learned those lessons the hard way.  Professionally, my background is primarily in operations, particularly dental practice management. I’ve also worked in commercial property management, and I’m currently working at a startup that is aiming to scale to $10 million within the next five years.  I want to build something meaningful again. I want to create real financial security for my family and eventually build wealth, but I feel like I’m at a crossroads.
